actions.description: Create an account in the Xero chart of accounts.

date.description: Transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: "2024-01-15"

Name.description: Full name of the contact. Max length 255.

ContactNumber.description: External identifier for the contact. Max length 50.

actions.description: Create a credit note for a contact
actions.name: create-credit-note

contact_id.description: Xero ContactID for the credit note. Example: "430fa14a-f945-44d3-9f97-5df5e28441b8"

date.description: Date the credit note is issued YYYY-MM-DD. Example: "2024-01-15"

account_code.description: Account code for the line item

tax_type.description: Tax type for the line item

item_code.description: Item code if referencing an existing item

line_items.description: Line items for the credit note

inventoryAssetAccountCode.description: Inventory asset account code for tracked inventory items.

cogsAccountCode.description: Cost of goods sold account code for purchase.
Cost of goods sold account code for sale.

itemId.description: Unique identifier of the created item.

updatedDateUTC.description: UTC timestamp of the last update.

actions.description: Create a payment against an invoice or credit note.
actions.name: create-payment

invoice_id.description: Xero Invoice ID to apply payment to.

credit_note_id.description: Xero Credit Note ID to apply payment to.

account_id.description: Xero Account ID to pay from.

account_code.description: Xero Account Code to pay from.

is_reconciled.description: Whether the payment should be created as reconciled.

actions.description: Create a purchase order for a contact.
actions.name: create-purchase-order

contact_id.description: Contact ID for the purchase order. Example: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"

date.description: Purchase order date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today if omitted.

unit_amount.description: Unit price of the item. Example: 50.00

account_code.description: Account code for the line item. Example: "200"

tax_type.description: Tax type for the line item. Example: "NONE"

line_items.description: Line items for the purchase order.

actions.description: List accounts in the Xero chart of accounts.
actions.name: list-accounts

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

where.description: Filter by any element. Example: Type=="BANK"

order.description: Order by any element returned. Example: Name ASC

Code.description: Customer defined alpha numeric account code. Example: "200"

EnablePaymentsToAccount.description: Whether account can have payments applied to it.

ShowInExpenseClaims.description: Whether account code is available for use with expense claims.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page if more results are available.

actions.description: List bank transactions with filters and pagination.
actions.name: list-bank-transactions

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

where.description: Filter by any element. Example: Status=="AUTHORISED" AND Type=="SPEND"

order.description: Order by any element returned. Example: Reference ASC

if_modified_since.description: If-Modified-Since header value. A UTC timestamp (yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss). Only bank transactions created or modified since this timestamp will be returned.

actions.description: List contacts with filters and pagination.
actions.name: list-contacts

where.description: Xero where filter clause. Example: Name.Contains("John")

ifModifiedSince.description: RFC 7231 datetime string for If-Modified-Since header

actions.description: List credit notes with filters and pagination.
actions.name: list-credit-notes

page.description: Page number for pagination. Up to 100 credit notes per page.

where.description: Filter by any element. Example: Status=="AUTHORISED"

order.description: Order by any element. Example: CreditNoteNumber ASC

modified_since.description: Only records created or modified since this timestamp (ISO 8601) will be returned. Maps to If-Modified-Since header.

actions.description: List invoices with filters and pagination.
actions.name: list-invoices

modifiedSince.description: If-Modified-Since header in UTC timestamp format. Example: "2023-01-01T00:00:00Z"

order.description: Order by expression. Example: Name ASC

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.

modified_since.description: If-Modified-Since header value in UTC format.

actions.name: list-payments

order.description: Order by expression e.g. Date ASC

if_modified_since.description: UTC timestamp in yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss format for the If-Modified-Since header

actions.description: List purchase orders with filters and pagination
actions.name: list-purchase-orders

Page.description: Page number for pagination. Starts at 1.

IfModifiedSince.description: ISO 8601 timestamp to return only records modified after this date.

actions.description: Update an existing account.
actions.name: update-account

code.description: Customer defined alpha numeric account code

enable_payments_to_account.description: Boolean to indicate if payments can be made to this account

show_in_expense_claims.description: Boolean to indicate if the account is available for use in expense claims

has_attachments.description: Boolean to indicate if the account has attachments

actions.description: Update an existing bank transaction.
actions.name: update-bank-transaction

bank_transaction_id.description: The Xero BankTransactionID to update. Example: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"

type.description: Transaction type. Example: SPEND or RECEIVE

date.description: Transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: "2024-01-15"

actions.description: Update an existing contact.
actions.name: update-contact

ContactID.description: Xero identifier for the contact. Example: "eaa28f49-6028-4b6e-bb12-d8f6278073fc"

ContactStatus.description: Current status of the contact, e.g. ACTIVE or ARCHIVED.

Name.description: Full name of the contact or organisation (max 255).

DefaultCurrency.description: Default currency for the contact, e.g. NZD.

IsCustomer.description: Whether the contact is a customer.

IsSupplier.description: Whether the contact is a supplier.

actions.description: Update an existing credit note.
actions.name: update-credit-note

actions.description: Update an existing invoice.
actions.name: update-invoice

InvoiceID.description: The Xero Invoice ID to update.

actions.description: Update an existing item.
actions.name: update-item

is_sold.description: When true the item will be available on sales transactions

is_purchased.description: When true the item is available for purchase transactions

description.description: The sales description of the item

purchase_description.description: The purchase description of the item

actions.description: Update an existing purchase order.
actions.name: update-purchase-order

purchase_order_id.description: Xero generated unique identifier for the purchase order. Example: "f9627f0d-b715-4039-bb6a-96dc3eae5ec5"

line_items.description: Line items for the purchase order

line_item_id.description: Line item ID for existing line items

date.description: Date purchase order was issued – YYYY-MM-DD

delivery_date.description: Date the goods are to be delivered – YYYY-MM-DD

line_amount_types.description: Line amount types: Exclusive, Inclusive, or NoTax

status.description: Status: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, AUTHORISED, BILLED, or DELETED

sent_to_contact.description: Boolean to set whether the purchase order should be marked as sent

delivery_address.description: The address the goods are to be delivered to

attention_to.description: The person that the delivery is going to

telephone.description: The phone number for the person accepting the delivery

delivery_instructions.description: A free text field for instructions (500 characters max)

expected_arrival_date.description: The date the goods are expected to arrive

currency_rate.description: The currency rate for a multicurrency purchase order
